name: An Ordinary Egg
label: Quest
description: Curgle Cranklehop works with ordinary hippogryph eggs, which are a coin toss: about half of them hatch. Curgle tends them and hopes for luck.
intro: Curgle Cranklehop works with ordinary hippogryph eggs, which are a coin toss: about half of them hatch. Curgle tends them and hopes for luck.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ordinary hippogryph eggs hatch about half the time. We do our best to nurture them and with a little luck, they will hatch.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So, you have found an ordinary egg, friend? Please give it to me... And we can only hope for the best.
I don't have much, but please accept this reward. If you ever find yourself in Feralas again, know that I am always here to take the eggs you find there.
